```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# some rendering environments default to a non-UTF-8 locale, which mangles
# accented characters (e.g. "für") when reading/writing publications.yml
try(Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "en_US.UTF-8"), silent = TRUE)

library(yaml)
source("R/pub_helpers.R")

pubs <- yaml::read_yaml("publications.yml")

# reverse chronological; radix sort is stable, so entries within the same
# year keep the order you gave them in publications.yml
articles <- pubs$articles
# Online-first pieces (online_first: true) always sort above dated
# entries, regardless of their placeholder `year`; within each group,
# reverse-chronological by year, and radix sort is stable so entries
# that tie on both keep the order you gave them in publications.yml
is_online_first <- sapply(articles, function(p) isTRUE(p$online_first))
articles <- articles[order(-is_online_first, -sapply(articles, function(p) p$year), method = "radix")]

manuscripts <- pubs$manuscripts
```

## Peer-Reviewed Articles

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}
render_category_filter(articles, "pub-article-list")
```

::: {#pub-article-list}
```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}
render_pub_list(articles)
```

<script type="text/javascript" src="https://d1bxh8uas1mnw7.cloudfront.net/assets/embed.js"></script>
<script async src="https://badge.dimensions.ai/static/ai/badge.js" charset="utf-8"></script>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll(".pub-filter-bar").forEach(function (bar) {
  var target = document.querySelector(bar.getAttribute("data-target"));
  if (!target) return;
  var entries = target.querySelectorAll(".pub-entry");
  bar.querySelectorAll(".pub-filter-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      bar.querySelectorAll(".pub-filter-btn").forEach(function (b) {
        b.classList.remove("active");
      });
      btn.classList.add("active");
      var filter = btn.getAttribute("data-filter");
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (filter === "all") {
          entry.style.display = "";
          return;
        }
        var cats = (entry.getAttribute("data-category") || "").split("|");
        entry.style.display = cats.indexOf(filter) !== -1 ? "" : "none";
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
